Nasal Congestion & Sinus Pressure Relief
Non-pharmacological measures for nasal discomfort: - Saline Spray: Use
sterile saline nasal sprays to keep nasal passages moist. - Warm Compress:
Apply a warm washcloth over your nose and forehead to ease sinus pressure.
